knownLimitsAndDeferred: Included Intel Mac, Windows and Linux prebuilds remain unverified/experimental; actual other-target execution is owner-deferred.
Available 18 GiB M3 Pro is not an 8 GiB reference-host test, 100 physical phones or a venue-network qualification.
All-polling full-game reliability and provider limits remain open; Quick Tunnel/DNS/network outages can interrupt service.
No new physical sleep/wake, terminal closure, clock-jump, clean-machine/quarantine, broader browser/keyboard or assistive-technology certification.
No paid publisher signing/notarization or independent publisher-signature root; integrity checks detect damaged bytes, not independently authenticate publisher identity.
